patch_list: HBO Max - Block SSAI Ad Origins

Reproduces the AdGuard DNS ad-block inside the app: fails media3 segment requests to HBO's SSAI ad origins (amer-free/emea-free.prd.media.max.com, gmss, FreeWheel) so the player's resiliency layer falls back to the clean, ad-free manifest…
HBO Max - Disable Ads

HBO Max - Playback Speed
Adds a remote-navigable on-screen speed control (0.5x–2.0x) to the HBO Max player. Opt-in; touches no DRM, ad, or network code. Not device-verified yet.
HBO Max - Prefer Ad-Free Stream

sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hide device identifiers
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hide rating prompt
Stops Google Play's rate-this-app sheet.
Hide VPN connection
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Remove social sign-in (phone)
Keeps Sign in with Google turned off. The Android TV app has no such option, so this does nothing there.
Report Wi-Fi connection
Makes the app see a Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data.
Skip ads
Blocks HBO Max's ad servers, so videos play without ads.
Spoof carrier
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
Video quality
Plays the video resolution you choose instead of letting the app pick one. Videos can buffer if your connection is too slow for it.
